name: Decline Sit Up (Weighted)
instructions: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and hold a plate against your chest.
Curl up and sit all the way up.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A decline sit-up with added load for more abdominal and hip-flexor strength.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
commonMistakes: Holding the weight behind the neck
safetyNotes: Keep the weight light; skip with low-back issues.
